# PR #3743: Patch: a job ran over 7 minutes

Closes #3736

I refreshed the `WEIGHTS` table in `apps/web/src/test/shardWeights.ts` from a fresh run of all eight `web (unit k/8)` shards. Locally the deal was already balanced, so the refresh barely moves the balance. I can't say whether it brings CI under 5 minutes, and my measurements don't explain why CI hit the 10-minute limit.

## What changed

- **Table:** `WEIGHTS` now lists 104 files of 3 s or more, down from 124. Files that no longer take 3 s dropped out.
- **Comment:** the doc comment above `WEIGHTS` names `main at 562883049a` and "refreshed in #3736".
- **Nothing else:** `git status` shows only that one file. The count stays at 8, the most `.github/ci/matrix.py` accepts.

## Before and after

Each run was one pass of the 8 shards on this 4-core machine, using the command in the plan. Both the baseline (old table, no tracked file changed) and the after run (new table) are included.

| Shard | Before: files | Before: seconds | After: files | After: seconds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1/8 | 70 | 137 | 70 | 130 |
| 2/8 | 71 | 119 | 72 | 112 |
| 3/8 | 72 | 111 | 74 | 112 |
| 4/8 | 74 | 134 | 73 | 113 |
| 5/8 | 73 | 127 | 73 | 122 |
| 6/8 | 74 | 118 | 73 | 109 |
| 7/8 | 75 | 120 | 75 | 113 |
| 8/8 | 76 | 111 | 75 | 111 |
| slowest / mean | | 1.12 | | 1.12 |

- **Slowest shard:** 137 s before, 130 s after. The ratio stayed at 1.12, so I did not tune further (the plan's limit for a second look is 1.25).
- **Spread:** the slowest-to-fastest gap closed from 26 s to 21 s.
- **Failures:** no test file failed in either run, so nothing was skipped or weakened.
- **Largest single file:** `almanac.test.tsx` took 120 s, below the 200 s where one file outgrows a shard's share, so I split nothing.
- **Per-file overhead:** `spacing.test.ts` showed `Duration 976ms (environment 54%, setup 26%, transform 14%, tests 3%, import 2%)`. A file that tests almost nothing still costs about 1 s, most of it environment and setup.

## What I checked

- `vitest run --project web apps/web/src/test/shardSequencer.test.ts`: 6 passed.
- `eslint apps/web/src/test/shardWeights.ts`: clean.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`: ran with no errors shown.
- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` built in about 3 minutes.

## Decisions

- **Only the table changed.** I rejected a size-based default weight, because file size and duration barely correlate (0.14 in the plan's figures; I did not recompute it). I rejected editing `vitest.config.ts` or `scripts/ci-shards.toml`, for the reasons in the plan (a config edit makes the harness rerun the whole suite; a comment edit there turns every Rust group on).
- **No new test.** The existing `shardSequencer.test.ts` checks the table's shape, and `dealShards` balances any table.
- **Short hash:** I wrote the 10-character output of `git rev-parse --short HEAD`.

## Things to look at twice

- **Locally this was already balanced.** All eight shards finished in 111–137 s with the old table, so the plan's diagnosis, that a stale table was dealing shards unevenly, is only mildly true. The refresh moves each shard by at most about 20 s.
- **CI's own timing is unknown until this pull request runs.** My measurements don't explain the 9m 42s and 9m 55s `failure` results. They could come from slower CI runners, from setup (checkout, install, artifact unpack), or from something that hangs on CI only. If `web (unit k/8)` still runs over 5 minutes, the refresh was not enough.

## For a person (none of it blocks this change)

1. **More shards.** If CI still shows a job over 5 minutes, the count must pass 8, and the bot cannot edit these files:
   - `.github/ci/matrix.py:29`: `MAX_SHARDS = 8` becomes `MAX_SHARDS = 12`.
   - `scripts/ci-shards.toml`: `unit = 8` becomes `unit = 12`, and the comments saying "1 to 8" and "8 is the most" are updated.
   - `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py`:
     - line 74: `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]` becomes `list(range(1, 13))`.
     - line 119: `"unit = 8"` becomes `"unit = 12"`.
     - line 130: `'"cards" = 9'` becomes `'"cards" = 13'`.
     - lines 130 to 134: every `"from 1 to 8"` becomes `"from 1 to 12"`, and the `"unit = 8"` in line 133 becomes `"unit = 12"`.
     - line 199: `["shard", "1", "9"]` becomes `["shard", "1", "13"]`.
   - Each extra shard costs a runner, and the repository shares 20.
2. **Heaviest files to the daily run.** The seven heaviest are `almanac.test.tsx` (120 s), `fullArtTiers.test.tsx` (95), `practice/driver.test.ts` (64), `CardFace.test.tsx` (49), `versionLooks.test.tsx` (47), `DeckWorkshop.test.tsx` (38) and `versionLooks3.test.tsx` (35).
